chunks: From Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) who said: Indeed, Allah the Exalted did not grant Satan authority over the believers.
Except for what they themselves allow him to have over them.
ai.seo_question: What is the source of Satan's authority over believers according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: In *Kamal al-Din*, Shaykh al-Saduq records Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) clarifying that Satan’s dominion is not an arbitrary divine decree but a contingent authority granted based on human agency and voluntary submission. This concept underscores the Shia theological principle of *Ikhtiyar* (free will), where the believer’s deeds determine the extent of Shaytan’s influence over their soul. It serves as a practical reminder that spiritual bondage is self-imposed through neglect of divine commands, while liberation is achieved through conscious adherence to God’s will.
